title: An ordinary tensor comparison determines its total and derived models
statement: For essentially small sites and independent commutative coefficient sheaves, let F be additive and exact, let A,B be closed derived tensor structures with models TA,TB, and let mu,nu be derived tensor comparisons with TensorComparisonModel data M,N [def-coef-semilinear-system-models].
